{
  "schema": "abyss.contract.v1",
  "contract_id": "abyss.rule_source_registry.v1",
  "purpose": "Declares the structure and semantics of the Rule Source Registry. Each rule source entry declares source files, affected scopes, consumers, context task inclusion, and validation commands.",
  "authority": "declarative_registry_only",
  "required_fields": [
    "schema",
    "purpose",
    "authority",
    "rule_sources",
    "hard_boundaries"
  ],
  "rule_source_entry_fields": {
    "required": ["source_files", "affected_scopes", "consumers", "context_task_types", "validation_commands", "description"],
    "optional": ["deprecated", "notes"]
  },
  "field_definitions": {
    "source_files": "List of relative file paths that constitute this rule source.",
    "affected_scopes": "List of task_type or scope identifiers affected by this rule source.",
    "consumers": "List of module names that read or depend on this rule source.",
    "context_task_types": "List of task types for which this rule source should be automatically included in context packs.",
    "validation_commands": "List of allowlisted commands that validate this rule source.",
    "description": "Human-readable description of the rule source purpose."
  },
  "hard_boundaries": [
    "Registry grants no execution or approval authority.",
    "Registry is declarative and discoverable only; it does not enforce runtime coupling.",
    "No event bus, daemon, real-time propagation, hot reload, broad rule engine, or automatic approval/execution authority.",
    "Missing or malformed rule_sources.v1.yaml must cause integrity check failure.",
    "Consumer declarations are informational; they do not create hard runtime dependencies.",
    "Validation commands must be from the executor allowlist only."
  ],
  "producer_modules": ["rule_registry", "integrity"],
  "consumer_modules": ["rule_registry", "context_broker", "integrity"],
  "runtime_records": [],
  "disclosure_level": "L5_contracts"
}

p = request_sub.add_parser("governance-surfaces", help="list protected governance-core surfaces")
    p.add_argument("--json", action="store_true")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_request_governance_surfaces)
    p_rules = sub.add_parser("rules", help="work with the Rule Source Registry")
    rules_sub = p_rules.add_subparsers(required=True)
    p = rules_sub.add_parser("list", help="list declared rule sources")
    p.add_argument("--json", action="store_true", help="render the rule sources as JSON")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_rules_list)
    p = rules_sub.add_parser("validate", help="validate the rule source registry")
    p.add_argument("--json", action="store_true", help="render validation as JSON")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_rules_validate)

# Get rule source files for this task type from Rule Source Registry
    rule_source_files: list[str] = []
    try:
        from .rule_registry import rule_sources_for_task_type
        rule_source_files = rule_sources_for_task_type(task_type)
    except (ImportError, SystemExit):
        pass  # Registry not yet available or file missing; degrade gracefully

    # Get module-derived files
    module_files = _get_module_files(required_modules)
